title: Mexican Ceviche
description: Mexican Ceviche is a dish from Mexico prepared with tilapia, lime juice, tomato, red onion. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Fully cooked fish rather than raw Mexican ceviche; citrus does not make raw fish reliably safe.

steps.instruction: Poach the fish until the flesh is opaque and reaches 63°C; cool quickly before dressing with lime and vegetables.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 30 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
